newsitem.title: UK: BA up on report raising hopes for on pact.
newsitem.headline: BA up on report raising hopes for on pact.

text.p: Shares in British Airways Plc rose 13p to 708-1/2p at 0723 GMT in pre-market trading on Thursday in reaction to a press report suggesting the air carriers chances of securing an alliance with AMR's American Airlines has improved.

The Financial Times newspaper reported American Airlines had improved its standing with the U.S. Congress by agreeing to a congressional report suggesting that other U.S. carriers would be given more slots at London's Heathrow Airport.

The newspaper said the positive reaction to the report could lead to Congress taking an easier stance towards the proposed alliance between British Airways and American Airlines. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 5106
